Privacy Policy

1. Introduction

Tow-botic Systems ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or submit an enquiry.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect the following information when you use our contact forms or request an assessment:

  • Name and company details
  • Work email address and telephone number
  • Vessel or project information you voluntarily provide
  • Technical data such as IP address and browser type (via analytics)

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information collected to:

  • Respond to your enquiry and provide application assessments
  • Improve our website and product offerings
  • Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

4. Data Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law. [Retention periods to be confirmed by owner.]

5. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with trusted service providers (such as hosting and analytics providers) who assist us in operating our website, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.

6. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us.

7. Contact Us
